answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**
一张分组柱图：3 个分段(SUPER GAMERS²/AVID GAMERS³/CASUAL GAMERS⁴)×3 个平台(MOBILE/CONSOLE/PC)，共 9 根柱。没有任何数值轴或刻度，只有一条基线，数字全部以 93%、82% 的形式印在柱顶外侧。图例不在上下方，而是贴在绘图区左侧的一列，每行由一个设备图标 + 文字 + 一条与柱色对应的横线组成。标题是整条蓝色色带：加粗的 “SHARE OF GAMERS¹ USING EACH PLATFORM FOR GAMING IN THE LAST 12 MONTHS” 后接常规体 “U.S., 2025, % GAMERS¹ BY SEGMENT”。绘图区带浅蓝六边形底纹，四处手绘风格的绿色椭圆圈住若干柱。

**定位一个值难在哪**
89% 在页面上出现两次：一次是 SUPER GAMERS² 的 PC 柱，一次是 AVID GAMERS³ 的 MOBILE 柱。要区分它们必须同时拿到分段名(x 轴)和平台名(左侧图例)，而平台与颜色的对应只靠图例文字下方那条细色线，没有色块，解析器很容易把两个 89% 混为一谈。

**不确定的**
图例三行的颜色横线是否真与柱色一一对应，只能按从上到下=从左到右推断；绿色椭圆到底圈了哪几根柱(Super Gamers 组似乎三根全圈)边界不清；页面无图号，是否属于更大编号体系无法判断。

heading.title: SHARE OF GAMERS¹ USING EACH PLATFORM FOR GAMING IN THE LAST 12 MONTHS

axes.serves: all nine bars, three per segment group

worked_example.why_hard: 89% appears twice on the page; only the legend colour rule separates Avid MOBILE from Super PC

components.evidence: three bars sit side by side inside each of SUPER GAMERS², AVID GAMERS³, CASUAL GAMERS⁴
only a black baseline under the bars; no ticks or numbers on any vertical axis
`93%`, `82%`, `89%` printed above the top of each bar, not inside it
hand-drawn green ellipses drawn over the plot around the Super Gamers bars, 89% and 87%
MOBILE / CONSOLE / PC stacked in a left-hand column level with the plot
`GAMERS¹`, `SUPER GAMERS²`, `AVID GAMERS³`, `CASUAL GAMERS⁴` superscripts keyed to notes 1-4
`Sources: Activate analysis, Activate 2025 Consumer Technology & Media Research Study (n = 4,026)`
banner ends `U.S., 2025, % GAMERS¹ BY SEGMENT`; no axis carries a unit
plot area filled with a pale blue hexagon/plus pattern instead of white
notes block under the plot wraps the four definitions across seven lines

new_components.name: icon_legend_entries
new_components.evidence: each legend row shows a phone / gamepad / monitor pictogram in a box left of MOBILE, CONSOLE, PC

new_components.name: legend_swatch_as_underline_rule
new_components.evidence: series colour shown only as a coloured horizontal rule under each legend label, no colour patch

new_components.name: handdrawn_ellipse_highlight
new_components.evidence: green marker-style ovals enclose whole groups of bars and their printed labels

new_components.name: heading_band_bold_plus_regular_runon
new_components.evidence: one blue band: bold title then regular `, U.S., 2025, % GAMERS¹ BY SEGMENT` continuing the same line

spot_checks.mark: the SUPER GAMERS² MOBILE bar (leftmost, dark navy)
the SUPER GAMERS² CONSOLE bar (middle, mid blue)
the SUPER GAMERS² PC bar (third, light teal)
the AVID GAMERS³ MOBILE bar (dark navy)
the CASUAL GAMERS⁴ MOBILE bar, circled in green
the CASUAL GAMERS⁴ PC bar (rightmost, shortest)

answer.hardest_step_why: 九个值全部印出，读数无碍；但 89% 出现两次，必须靠左侧图例的 MOBILE/PC 与分段名双标签才能区分。

examples.quote: Blue band above the plot: bold "SHARE OF GAMERS¹ USING EACH PLATFORM...LAST 12 MONTHS" then regular ", U.S., 2025, % GAMERS¹ BY SEGMENT"
examples.why: 标题、地域年份与单位在同一条色带里连排，现有管线只能输出单一标题字符串。

examples.quote: No vertical axis or ticks at all; only a baseline, with 93%, 82%, 89% printed above each bar
examples.why: 整图无数值轴，数值只存在于柱顶外侧标签，需把标签位置作为独立样式维度生成。

examples.quote: Green hand-drawn ovals encircling the three Super Gamers bars, the 89% Avid bar and the 87% Casual bar
examples.why: 跨多根柱的手绘椭圆强调层，现有生成器无标注图层；应新增 emphasis_overlay 维度。

examples.quote: Left column: device icons boxed beside MOBILE, CONSOLE, PC, each underlined by a rule in that series' colour
examples.why: 图例为侧栏图标行、且颜色以下划线而非色块表示，需新增图例排版与色标形态维度。
